canon: The most important question in the new space-security story is not simply whether satellites can be attacked. It is this: Is the weapon itself in orbit? He said they were meant to protect U.S. forces from hostile actions. An official U.S. Space Force article published the next day described this as the first public acknowledgment that the Space Force had put weapons in orbit.
